messages:
Maria Chen (Security PM): Heads-up — customer asks keep coming for 7+ year audit log retention and per-tenant export. We need to decide scope for Q2 roadmap: SOC2 alignment, export SLA, and whether HSM-backed retention is a launch blocker. Thoughts?
Aj Patel (Eng): Short: long retention is doable but big storage + egress cost. Need quant on volume + query patterns. Also indexing/search for forensic queries will add infra work.
Ian Gomez (CustSuccess): Pinging with two enterprise customers: one regulated fintech wants 7 years immutable logs; another wants 3 years but with per-tenant on-demand export and legal-hold. Both cite audit readiness.
Elaine Park (Product): We should surface clear launch criteria. Proposal: MVP = 1 year immutable retention + per-tenant export API + SOC2 evidence export. Post-MVP: tiered retention up to 7y with HSM option for encrypted immutability.
Simone Ruiz (Legal): From legal perspective, we need tamper-evidence and chain-of-custody metadata for any retention >1y. HSM helps but policy + audit trails matter more than just HSM.
Aj Patel (Eng): Agree on priorities. Engineering asks: define SLA for export (e.g., 48h/7d), export formats (ndjson/parquet), and expected volumes. Also need decision on whether retention storage is on-hosted infra or cold storage.
Maria Chen (Security PM): Drafting launch criteria now. Quick sketch: 
```
LAUNCH CRITERIA (initial):
- SOC2 evidence export via UI + API (on-demand)
- Immutable retention: configurable 90d/1y default, admin opt-in for longer tiers
- Per-tenant export API with 7d SLA for small volumes (<=50GB), 48h for >50GB backlog
- KMS integration for envelope keys; HSM option documented but not required for MVP
- Audit trail: tamper-evident metadata + retention policy change log
```
Any objections?
Ian Gomez (CustSuccess): Customers will want better SLA for big exports. If we make >50GB 48h, some will still push. Can we add a paid expedited export?
Elaine Park (Product): Yup, we can productize expedited exports as a billable add-on. Need to confirm pricing model with finance later.
Simone Ruiz (Legal): Also require key rotation policy documented and proof for auditors. If we say HSM not required, we must still show KMS crypto controls and rotation logs.
Aj Patel (Eng): Technical risk: implementing immutable retention w/out HSM relies on write-once policies and storage-level immutability (e.g., object lock). We'll need to pick providers and test restore/verify flows.
Maria Chen (Security PM): Action items: Aj to prototype retention + export flow (P0); Elaine to own product PRD and pricing + customer comms (P0); Simone to draft legal requirements checklist for auditors (P1); Ian to collect customer volume samples (P0).
Aj Patel (Eng): I'll start a spike this week. ETA for prototype: 3 weeks. Will include cost estimate.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: retention-spike branch to staging. 1719977805 by aj-patel — running smoke tests. :rocket:
Maria Chen (Security PM): Great. We'll sync in weekly roadmap sync. If anyone has blocker items (e.g., compliance gaps), flag here. :eyes:
Ian Gomez (CustSuccess): I'll send sample logs + retention requests from customers by EOD tomorrow.
Elaine Park (Product): One more ask: include rollback policy in PRD — if export fails partially, how we alert customers and retry.
Aj Patel (Eng): Noted. I'll add retry semantics and idempotent export tokens to the prototype.
Simone Ruiz (Legal): Also add consent/audit wording for exports in TOS addendum. I'll draft language for review.
Maria Chen (Security PM): Thanks team. Putting tentative OKR line: "Support enterprise-grade audit retention & export (SOC2 evidence + per-tenant exports) — launch criteria defined and prototype validated by end of Q2." We'll refine cadence in roadmap sync. :white_check_mark:
